## FAQ

 What does York Space Systems (YSS) change in this amended filing? 

 York Space Systems updates the share component of its Solestial acquisition. The amendment clarifies how many common shares were issued and at what negotiated value, while leaving all other terms from the earlier report unchanged. 

 How many York Space Systems shares were issued for the Solestial acquisition? 

 York Space Systems issued 1,703,577 common shares for the Solestial deal. These shares formed part of the merger consideration paid at closing, alongside cash, to reach an overall purchase price of about $67 million. 

 What was the purchase price York Space Systems paid for Solestial, Inc.? 

 York Space Systems paid approximately $67 million to acquire Solestial. This amount was delivered at closing using a mix of cash and 1,703,577 common shares valued at $34.00 per share under the negotiated merger terms. 

 At what price were York Space Systems shares valued in the Solestial deal? 

 The Solestial acquisition valued York Space Systems shares at $34.00 each. The company used this negotiated per-share value when issuing 1,703,577 common shares as part of the approximately $67 million purchase price at closing. 

 Were the York Space Systems shares issued in the Solestial acquisition registered? 

 No, the York Space Systems shares issued were unregistered. The company relied on exemptions from registration under the Securities Act of 1933, including Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D, to issue the merger consideration shares. 

 When did York Space Systems close its acquisition of Solestial, Inc.? 

 York Space Systems closed the Solestial acquisition on June 4, 2026. On that date, the company delivered the agreed purchase price of about $67 million using a mix of cash and 1,703,577 unregistered common shares.
